F-ZON-16 | packing_rework.location = Zone F | Packing rework is carried out in Zone F.; F-ZON-17 | labelling.location = Zone F | Labelling is carried out in Zone F.; F-ZON-18 | kitting.location = Zone F | Kitting is carried out in Zone F.; F-ZON-19 | unloading_equipment.staging_location = Zone A wall | Unloading equipment is staged along the Zone A wall.; F-ZON-20 | temperature_affected_stock.quarantine_location = Zone F | Pallets found outside permitted temperature range are moved to quarantine in Zone F for assessment.; F-ORD-10 | pallet_transfer.zone_sequence = Zone A -> Zone B -> Zone C -> Zone D | Pallets transfer from Zone A to Zone B to Zone C to Zone D.

F-ORD-11 | leveller.deployment_order = vehicle braked, chocked and stationary, then deploy leveller | The dock leveller must be deployed only after the vehicle is braked, chocked and confirmed stationary at the door.; F-ORD-12 | leveller.operation_sequence = check, then position and extend lip, then confirm seating | Dock levellers must be operated in order: check for damage or obstruction, then position and extend the lip, then confirm stable seating before movements.

F-ZON-21 | cycle_count.coverage_zones = Zone B, Zone C, Zone E, Zone F quarantine area | Cycle counts are performed across Zone B racking, Zone C pick faces, Zone E and the Zone F quarantine area.; F-ZON-22 | returns_restock.destination = Zone B or Zone C | Restocked returns are placed in Zone B or Zone C.; F-RSP-09 | inbound_exceptions.review_owner = stock_controller | Inbound exceptions are segregated for stock-controller review.

F-SCH-11 | weekly_roster.publication_deadline = before working week starts | The weekly roster must be published before the working week starts.; F-SCH-12 | shift_handover.time = 14:00 | Shift handover between Shift 1 and Shift 2 occurs at 14:00 every working day.; F-ROL-10 | shift_supervisor.assignment_per_shift = 1 | One shift supervisor is assigned to each shift.; F-RSP-10 | shift_handover.briefing_owner = outgoing shift supervisor | The outgoing shift supervisor must brief the incoming shift supervisor face to face and sign the handover record.

F-ORD-13 | shift_handover.preparation_order = floor walk, then handover meeting | The floor walk to confirm the state of receiving, storage, picking and dispatch areas must happen before the handover meeting.; F-RUL-04 | shift_handover.floor_coverage = never unattended during handover | The floor must never be left unattended during the handover discussion.; F-RSP-11 | handover_record.signing_parties = both shift supervisors | Both outgoing and incoming shift supervisors must jointly sign the handover record only when both accept the stated floor position.

F-ORD-14 | cycle_count.movement_pause_order = count closed, then put-away and picking | Counted locations must remain clear of put-away and picking until the count is closed.; F-ORD-15 | inbound_exceptions.review_order = stock-controller review, then booking or put-away | Inbound exceptions must be held for stock-controller review before booking or put-away.

F-ZON-23 | nonconforming_goods.segregation_location = Zone A | Non-conforming inbound goods must be segregated within Zone A.; F-ORD-16 | receiving.unloading_inspection_order = unloading before inspection | At receiving, unloading happens BEFORE inspection.

F-ORD-17 | inbound_labelling.verification_movement_order = scan verification, then move from inspection area | Each inbound label must be scan-verified against the system receipt before the unit is moved from the inspection area.

F-ZON-24 | heavy_pallet.storage_level = lower beam levels | Heavy pallets must be distributed to lower beam levels and not concentrated beyond bay rating.; F-RUL-05 | block_stacking.allowed_condition = only where racking unavailable and system directs | Free block stacking is allowed only where racking locations are not available and the system explicitly directs block stacking.; F-ZON-25 | damaged_pallet.reassessment_location = inspection area | Damaged pallets, collapsed loads or overweight units must be returned to the inspection area for reassessment.; F-RSP-12 | racking_damage.notification_recipient = maintenance_technician | Any upright damage, beam deformation, missing safety pins or anchor failure observed during put-away must be notified to the maintenance technician at once.; F-RUL-06 | damaged_rack_bay.reuse_condition = blocked until cleared and released | No further put-away to a damaged or overloaded bay is allowed until the bay is cleared and released.

F-ZON-26 | chilled_product.storage_location = Zone E | All chilled product requiring controlled refrigeration must be stored in Zone E.; F-ZON-27 | chilled_pallet.inbound_transfer_route = inbound inspection area directly to Zone E, no ambient staging | Chilled pallets must transfer directly between the inbound inspection area and Zone E without staging in ambient areas.; F-ZON-28 | chilled_pallet.outbound_transfer_route = Zone E directly to dispatch staging area | Outbound chilled pallets must move directly from Zone E to the dispatch staging area for prompt loading.; F-RUL-07 | zone_e.entry_restriction = put-away, replenishment, picking, stock counting or supervision personnel only | Entry to Zone E is restricted to personnel engaged in put-away, replenishment, picking, stock counting or supervision of those tasks.; F-ORD-18 | zone_e_stock.rotation_order = incoming behind existing, earliest expiry first | In Zone E incoming batches must be placed behind existing stock and the earliest expiry picked first unless the system directs otherwise.; F-ORD-19 | temperature_affected_stock.release_order = assessment, then return to Zone E or release for picking | Pallets found outside the permitted temperature range must complete assessment before return to Zone E or release for picking.
The canon requires non-conforming inbound goods to be segregated within Zone A, not in Zone F quarantine.

message: F-SCH-13 | hazmat_cage.inspection_frequency = each shift | The hazmat cage must be inspected each shift for leaks, damaged packaging, missing labels and blocked access.; F-ORD-20 | hazmat_cage.weight_verification_transport_order = verify running total, then transport | The running cage weight total must be verified before transporting any additional pallet to the hazmat cage.; F-ORD-21 | quarantine_stock.release_order = assessment, then move to destination | Quarantined pallets may be moved out only after authorised assessment releases them to their system-directed destination.; F-ZON-29 | hazmat_overflow.storage_location = not in quarantine area | Hazmat overflow must never be stored in the quarantine area.; F-ZON-30 | quarantined_general_stock.storage_location = not in hazmat cage | Quarantined general stock must never be stored inside the hazmat cage.

F-ZON-31 | replenishment.source_zone = Zone B | Replenishment reserve stock must be drawn only from Zone B.; F-ZON-32 | replenishment.destination_zone = Zone C | Replenishment must be delivered only to Zone C pick faces and flow-rack lanes.; F-ZON-33 | excess_stock.return_location = Zone B reserve location | Excess or mis-directed stock must be returned to its Zone B reserve location and not staged in picking aisles.; F-ORD-22 | replenishment.scan_verification_order = source scan, then destination scan | Replenishment scan verification must occur at source removal before destination placement.; F-ORD-23 | replenishment.priority_order = urgent and short first, then remaining scheduled | Urgent and short pick faces must be replenished before remaining scheduled top-ups.

F-ORD-24 | picking.scan_verification_order = source location label, then item or carton | In Zone C picking, the source location label must be scanned before scanning each picked item or carton.; F-RSP-13 | scanner_shortage.report_recipient = shift_supervisor | Any scanner shortage or fault must be reported to the shift supervisor immediately.; F-ZON-34 | scanner.charging_location = charging station | Handheld WMS scanners are collected from and returned to the charging station for charging.; F-ZON-35 | completed_totes.collection_location = marked collection point | Completed scan-verified totes must be left in the marked collection point.; F-ZON-36 | picking_waste.disposal_location = waste cages | Picking waste such as stretch film, strapping and empty cartons must be removed to waste cages.

F-ZON-37 | packing.location = Zone D | Packing under PR-05 is executed in Zone D before transfer to loading.; F-ZON-38 | stretch_wrapper.location = Zone D | Outbound pallet stretch wrappers are located in dispatch in Zone D.; F-LIM-16 | handling_unit.principal_label_count = 1 label | Each handling unit carries one principal label.; F-ORD-25 | packing.label_confirmation_order = confirm label data before sealing | Label data must be confirmed against the outbound load record before sealing.; F-ORD-26 | outbound_pallet.wrap_stage_order = wrapping before staging | Outbound pallets must be wrapped before staging in Zone D.; F-ORD-27 | staging_lane.system_record_release_order = system recording before release for loading | Packed units, labels and wrapped pallets must be recorded in the system before releasing the staging lane for loading.

F-ORD-28 | outbound_load.release_movement_order = dispatcher release, then move to door | A staging lane may be moved to a door only after the dispatcher has released that outbound load in the system.; F-RSP-14 | loading_exception.notification_recipient = dispatcher | Any scan mismatch, short pallet or damaged wrapping during loading must be notified to the dispatcher and loading stopped.; F-RUL-08 | outbound_load.lane_substitution_rule = prohibited | Pallets must never be substituted from another lane to complete an outbound load.; F-ORD-29 | evacuation_resumption.verification_continuation_order = re-verify door, vehicle and count, then continue | After authorised re-entry following evacuation, the open door, vehicle position and staged count must be re-verified before continuing loading.

F-ZON-39 | defective_equipment.quarantine_location = designated quarantine line | Defective MHE must be parked in the designated quarantine line.; F-ZON-40 | electric_truck.charging_location = designated charging positions | Electric trucks must be charged only in designated charging positions.; F-RSP-15 | truck.return_to_use_authority = maintenance_technician | Only the maintenance technician may return a truck with overdue planned maintenance to use.; F-SCH-14 | reach_truck.daily_check = daily | Each reach truck requires a documented pre-use check each day.; F-SCH-15 | electric_pallet_jack.daily_check = daily | Each electric pallet jack requires a documented pre-use check each day.

F-RUL-09 | forklift.overtaking_restriction = prohibited in rack storage aisle, dock ramp and leveller approach, marked pedestrian zone | Trucks must never overtake another truck in a rack storage aisle, on a dock ramp or leveller approach, or in a marked pedestrian zone.

F-ORD-30 | wrapper.inspection_order = check before wrapping run | Wrapper turntable, film carriage and controls must be checked for damage or film breaks before starting each wrapping run.; F-RSP-16 | wrapper_fault.notification_recipient = maintenance_technician | Unusual wrapper noise, uneven wrapping or control failure must be notified to the maintenance technician after isolating the wrapper.; F-ORD-31 | baler.tie_ejection_order = tie off before ejection | Each baler bale must be tied off before ejection after a full compression cycle.; F-ZON-41 | finished_bale.storage_location = clear of wrapper lanes, staging lanes and dock approaches | Finished bales must be stored clear of wrapper lanes, staging lanes and dock approaches until collection.; F-ORD-32 | dock_leveller.return_order = return to stored position and close door after vehicle departs | Each dock leveller must be returned to its stored position and the dock door closed immediately after the vehicle departs.; F-RSP-17 | dock_leveller_defect.notification_recipient = maintenance_technician | Bent leveller lips, sticking decks, oil leaks, missing edge guards or obstructed pits must be reported to the maintenance technician.

F-RSP-18 | walkway_defect.report_recipient = shift_supervisor | Faded walkway lines, damaged barriers, blocked crossings or obscured signage must be reported to the shift supervisor.; F-ORD-33 | pedestrian_crossing.crossing_order = Stop, look and eye contact, then step out | At marked crossings pedestrians must stop at the edge, look both ways and make eye contact before stepping out.; F-ORD-34 | visitor_briefing.briefing_entry_order = Briefing, then floor entry | Visitors and new starters must be briefed on PR-11 before entering the floor.

F-RSP-19 | seat_belt.defect_notification_recipient = maintenance_technician | A cut, frayed, jammed or non-latching forklift seat belt must be notified to the maintenance technician.; F-ZON-42 | spare_ppe.storage_location = charging station area | Spare compliant vests and footwear are held at the charging station area.

F-ORD-35 | cycle_count.scan_verification_order = location label, then item or carton | Cycle counts must scan the location label first, then scan every item or carton in that location.; F-RUL-10 | cycle_count.first_count_entry_method = direct scanner entry, no paper transcription unless system unavailable and fallback authorised | First counts must be entered directly into the scanner with no paper transcription unless the system is unavailable and the fallback is authorised.; F-PRC-16 | stock_adjustment.documentation_requirement = reason code, both count quantities, scanner identity and operator identity | Each posted stock adjustment must record the reason code, both count quantities, scanner identity and operator identity.; F-SCH-16 | unresolved_variance.carry_forward_deadline = next working day | Unresolved count variances must be carried forward to the next working day.

F-ORD-36 | stocktake.zone_release_order = sign-off or authorised partial release, then release | Frozen zones must be released only after stocktake sign-off or authorised partial release.; F-ORD-37 | stocktake.restart_order = system reflects approved adjustments, then restart booking, put-away and picking | The system must reflect approved adjustments before restarting inbound booking, put-away and order picking.

F-ORD-38 | damaged_stock.pr09_assessment_posting_order = PR-09 assessment before stock adjustment posting | Every adjustment arising from damage must complete PR-09 Damaged-goods handling assessment before posting against inventory.; F-ORD-39 | damaged_goods.write_off_approval_posting_order = write-off approval before stock adjustment posting | Damaged-goods write-off approval must be obtained before posting the corresponding stock adjustment.; F-RUL-11 | damaged_goods.threshold_split = prohibited | A single damage event must not be split into smaller values to remain below the approval threshold.; F-ORD-40 | overloaded_bay.redistribution_posting_order = redistribute load before posting adjustment | Where recounts confirm overstock above bay limits, the load must be redistributed before posting the adjustment.

F-ORD-41 | returns_receipt.verification_movement_order = verify delivery date, customer reference and reason code before moving goods inward | Authorised returns must have delivery date, customer reference and reason code verified against the system record before moving the goods inward.; F-ZON-43 | returns_rework.holding_location = Zone F | Approved rework units must be transferred to the designated rework holding position inside Zone F.; F-ORD-42 | returns_disposition.approval_execution_order = shift-supervisor approval before restock, rework or scrap execution | No restock, rework or scrap of inspected returns may proceed without prior shift-supervisor approval of the disposition.

F-ZON-44 | rework.location = Zone F | Rework is carried out in Zone F.; F-ORD-43 | returns_value_added.release_order = inspection before value-added work | Returns must be inspected in Zone F under PR-07 before any unit is released to value-added work.; F-RUL-12 | packing_rework.authorization_requirement = system task or supervisor instruction | Packing rework in Zone F may be carried out only against a system task or supervisor instruction.; F-ORD-44 | damaged_component.assessment_use_order = PR-09 assessment before further use | Components found damaged during rework must complete PR-09 assessment before further use.; F-ZON-45 | excess_components.return_location = system-directed locations | Excess components and unused packaging must be returned to system-directed locations and never staged in picking aisles.

F-RSP-20 | temperature_record.review_owner = shift_supervisor | The shift supervisor must review each shift cold-zone temperature record and investigate any deviation.; F-ZON-46 | backup_monitoring_devices.storage_location = charging station area | Backup cold-zone monitoring devices are held available at the charging station area.; F-RUL-13 | zone_e.operation_suspension_during_recovery = suspend replenishment and picking during recovery | Routine replenishment and picking in Zone E must be suspended while temperature recovery is in progress after a verified excursion.; F-ORD-45 | temperature_recovery.resumption_order = successive stable readings before resume | Restoration of the +2 to +8 C condition must be confirmed through successive stable readings before resuming normal chilled operations.

F-RSP-21 | evacuation.missing_person_report_recipient = shift_supervisor | Missing persons, last known location and nature of the emergency must be reported to the shift supervisor at the assembly point.; F-ORD-46 | truck_securing.leaving_order = lower forks, apply parking brake and switch off, then leave | Before leaving a truck during evacuation forks must be lowered fully, parking brake applied and truck switched off.; F-ORD-47 | re_entry.authorisation_order = all-clear and confirmed safe condition, then authorise re-entry | Re-entry may be authorised only after the all-clear and confirmed safe condition of the building.; F-SCH-17 | corrective_actions.implementation_deadline = before next working day | Agreed corrections to signage, routes, lighting or briefing must be implemented before the next working day.; F-PRC-17 | drill_log.required_contents = date, evacuation time, attendance, deficiencies | Each drill log entry must record drill date, evacuation time, attendance and deficiencies.
Operator Authorisation and Daily Checks (331 words)

F-ORD-48 | reach_truck.inspection_order = daily check, then first use | Each reach truck requires a documented pre-use check before first use each day.; F-ORD-49 | electric_pallet_jack.inspection_order = daily check, then first use | Each electric pallet jack requires a documented pre-use check before first use each day.; F-ORD-50 | daily_check.logging_movement_order = record in log, then move truck | Each daily truck check must be recorded in the designated log before moving the truck.; F-RSP-22 | truck_defect.notification_recipient = maintenance_technician | Every defect found during truck checks or operation must be notified to the maintenance technician.
Speed Limits and Driving Rules (365 words)

F-ZON-47 | handling_equipment.parking_location = outside Zone E unless actively loading or unloading | Handling equipment must be parked outside Zone E unless actively loading or unloading.; F-PRC-18 | cold_zone_temperature_verification.required_contents = reading, measuring device identity and time of check | Each cold-zone temperature verification must record the reading, the measuring device identity and the time of check.; F-RUL-14 | cold_zone_doors.closing_requirement = closed immediately after each movement, never wedged open | Cold-zone doors must be closed immediately after each pallet or personnel movement and never wedged open.
Site Layout and Dock Discipline (420 words)

F-ORD-51 | putaway.location_verification_lift_order = verify system-directed location before lifting | Put-away requires verification of the system-directed location before lifting any pallet to height.; F-RSP-23 | rack_bay.release_authority = maintenance_technician | A damaged or overloaded rack bay must be cleared and released by the maintenance technician before reloading.

F-ZON-48 | hazmat_storage.authorized_location = hazmat cage inside Zone F | All hazardous materials must be stored only in the hazmat cage inside Zone F.; F-ZON-49 | running_total.display_location = cage entrance | The visible running weight total must be maintained at the cage entrance.; F-RUL-15 | hazmat_cage.entry_restriction = trained personnel assigned to hazmat task only | Entry to the hazmat cage is allowed only to trained personnel assigned to the hazmat task.; F-LIM-17 | hazmat_transport.batch_size = 1 pallets | Hazmat pallets must be transported one at a time.; F-RSP-24 | new_hazmat_line.approval_authority = warehouse_manager | The warehouse manager must give prior approval before accepting any new hazmat line or increased stock.; F-SCH-18 | hazmat_cage.audit_frequency = daily | Cage stock weight, pallet count and documentation must be audited daily.; F-ORD-52 | running_total.update_order = placement and removal, then update | The running total must be updated immediately after each placement and each removal.
Spills, Quarantine and Damaged Goods (431 words)

F-RSP-25 | spill.notification_recipient = shift_supervisor | Any leak, spill or damaged container must be notified to the shift supervisor without delay.; F-RSP-26 | damage_dispute.decision_owner = shift_supervisor | Any dispute over damaged-goods value or responsibility must be escalated to the shift supervisor for decision.; F-SCH-19 | spill_damage_event.review_timing = at shift handover | Every spill and damage event must be reviewed at shift handover.; F-SCH-20 | quarantine_records.closure_deadline = before next shift starts | All open quarantine records must be closed before the next shift starts.

F-PRC-19 | incident_report.required_contents = time, exact location, persons involved, equipment involved, description | Each incident report must provide the time, exact location, persons involved, equipment involved and a brief description of what happened.; F-SCH-21 | incident_report.logging_deadline = before end of shift in designated incident log | The initial incident report must be recorded in the designated incident log before the end of the shift in which the event occurred.

F-RSP-27 | roll_call.conductor = shift_supervisor | The shift supervisor conducts roll call of all floor staff, visitors and contractors at the assembly point.; F-RSP-28 | emergency_services.liaison_authority = shift_supervisor or warehouse_manager | Liaison with the emergency services must go only through the shift supervisor or the warehouse manager.; F-RSP-29 | post_evacuation_work.resumption_authority = shift_supervisor | Work may resume after re-entry only when instructed by the shift supervisor.
F-RSP-30 | defective_equipment.return_to_use_authority = maintenance_technician | Defective equipment must stay isolated from service until the maintenance technician clears it for return to use.

F-RSP-31 | transport_arrival_window.informed_parties = carriers and floor team | The dispatcher communicates arrival windows to carriers and the floor team.; F-RSP-32 | dispatcher_handover.briefing_recipient = incoming dispatcher | The outgoing dispatcher briefs the incoming dispatcher on open loads for handover.
The canon requires document check then unloading (F-ORD-01) and inspection then booking (F-ORD-02), so booking occurs after unloading and inspection, not before unloading.

message: Inbound Receiving Hours and Intake (286 words)

F-RUL-16 | carrier_arrival.booking_requirement = pre-booked slot | All carrier arrivals require a pre-booked slot.; F-SCH-22 | inbound_vehicle.processing_deadline = day of arrival | Booked inbound vehicles received within published receiving hours must complete document check, unloading, inspection and system booking on the day of arrival.; F-RSP-33 | inbound_exception.notification_recipient = carrier | The carrier is notified when inspection identifies shortage, damage or documentation mismatch.

F-RUL-17 | carrier_loading.door_slot_requirement = assigned door and slot only | Carriers must be loaded only against the dispatcher-assigned dock door and time slot.; F-ORD-53 | order_preparation.handover_order = PR-05 before PR-06 | All orders are prepared under PR-05 Packing and labelling before handover to PR-06 Outbound dispatch for staging and loading.; F-PRC-20 | unreleased_load.rebooking_action = rebook to next available door and slot | Loads not released by the dispatcher-confirmed cut-off time for the booked slot are rebooked to the next available door and slot.; F-RSP-34 | rebooked_load.notified_party = client | The client is notified of the revised departure when a load is rebooked to a new door and slot.

F-RSP-35 | replenishment_shortfall.notified_party = client | Replenishment shortfalls affecting wave start must be notified to the client record.; F-RUL-18 | picking.task_requirement = live system tasks only, no paper substitute where available | PR-04 order picking must be executed only against live system tasks on handheld devices with no paper-based substitute picking where system tasks are available.; F-ORD-54 | picking.tote_transfer_order = scan verification, then tote transfer | Each pick must be scan-verified at the pick face before tote transfer.

F-SCH-23 | capacity_allocation.balance_review_frequency = each working day | Bulk and picking balances across the 2,400 pallet positions are reviewed on each working day.

F-RSP-36 | stocktake_plan.approval_authority = warehouse_manager | The warehouse manager approves the annual stocktake plan.; F-PRC-21 | stocktake_reconciliation.required_contents = opening position, counts, adjustments and closing position | The post-stocktake client reconciliation must show opening position, counts, adjustments and closing position.; F-PRC-22 | cycle_count_report.required_contents = locations counted, hit rate and open variances | The client cycle-count report must include locations counted, hit rate and open variances.

F-SCH-24 | damaged_stock.segregation_deadline = day of discovery | Damaged, suspect and non-conforming stock must be segregated to quarantine on the day of discovery.; F-SCH-25 | quarantine_status.reporting_frequency = daily | Quarantine status forms part of daily operational reporting.; F-SCH-26 | quarantine_holdings.reconciliation_timing = month end | All quarantine holdings in Zone F are reconciled against incident reports and write-off approvals at month end.; F-PRC-23 | quarantine_assessment.required_contents = photographic evidence, quantity, value and cause | Each PR-09 quarantine assessment must retain photographic evidence, quantity, value and cause against the client stock record.
F-RSP-37 | returns.late_exception_authority = client | Requests after the 14-day returns window require prior written exception agreement by the client before goods are returned to site.

F-SCH-27 | zone_e_monitoring.frequency = continuous | Zone E operates continuous monitoring with automated alerting for excursion risk.; F-RSP-38 | excursion_response.initiator = shift_supervisor | The shift supervisor initiates the PR-12 excursion response when a deviation from +2 to +8 C is indicated.; F-RSP-39 | temperature_excursion.notified_party = client | Clients receive notification of any verified excursion affecting their stock.
